require('dotenv').config(); const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js'); const supabaseUrl = process.env.SUPABASE_URL; const supabaseKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY; if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseKey) { throw new Error('SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY/SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are required.'); } module.exports = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseKey, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } });

class ApiError extends Error { constructor(status, message) { super(message); this.status = status; } } module.exports = ApiError;

const ApiError = require('../utils/ApiError'); module.exports = (err, req, res, next) => { if (err instanceof ApiError) { return res.status(err.status).json({ error: err.message }); } const status = err.status || err.statusCode || 500; const message = err.message || 'Internal Server Error'; if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') { console.error(err); } return res.status(status).json({ error: message }); };

const supabase = require('../config/supabase'); const ApiError = require('../utils/ApiError'); const RESERVED_QUERY_PARAMS = new Set(['select', 'limit', 'offset', 'order']); class BaseModel { constructor(tableName, options = {}) { this.table = tableName; this.defaultOrder = options.defaultOrder || 'created_at.desc'; } parsePagination(query = {}) { const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(query.limit) || 100, 1), 1000); const offset = Math.max(Number(query.offset) || 0, 0); return { limit, offset }; } applyOrder(queryBuilder, order) { const selectedOrder = order || this.defaultOrder; if (!selectedOrder) return queryBuilder; const [column, direction] = selectedOrder.split('.'); return queryBuilder.order(column, { ascending: direction !== 'desc' }); } async list(query = {}) { const { select = '*', order, ...filters } = query; const { limit, offset } = this.parsePagination(query); let request = supabase.from(this.table).select(select).range(offset, offset + limit - 1); request = this.applyOrder(request, order); for (const [column, value] of Object.entries(filters)) { if (!RESERVED_QUERY_PARAMS.has(column)) { request = request.eq(column, value); } } const { data, error } = await request; if (error) throw new ApiError(400, error.message); return data; } async findById(id, select = '*') { const { data, error } = await supabase.from(this.table).select(select).eq('id', id).maybeSingle(); if (error) throw new ApiError(400, error.message); if (!data) throw new ApiError(404, `${this.table} record not found.`); return data; } async findOne(filters = {}, select = '*') { let request = supabase.from(this.table).select(select); for (const [column, value] of Object.entries(filters)) { request = request.eq(column, value); } const { data, error } = await request.maybeSingle(); if (error) throw new ApiError(400, error.message); if (!data) throw new ApiError(404, `${this.table} record not found.`); return data; } async create(payload = {}) { const { data, error } = await supabase.from(this.table).insert(payload).select().single(); if (error) throw new ApiError(400, error.message); return data; } async updateById(id, payload = {}) { const { data, error } = await supabase.from(this.table).update(payload).eq('id', id).select().maybeSingle(); if (error) throw new ApiError(400, error.message); if (!data) throw new ApiError(404, `${this.table} record not found.`); return data; } async deleteById(id) { const { data, error } = await supabase.from(this.table).delete().eq('id', id).select('id').maybeSingle(); if (error) throw new ApiError(400, error.message); if (!data) throw new ApiError(404, `${this.table} record not found.`); return { deleted: true, id }; } } module.exports = BaseModel;

const BaseModel = require('./baseModel'); const supabase = require('../config/supabase'); const ApiError = require('../utils/ApiError'); class GroupMemberModel extends BaseModel { constructor() { super('group_members', { defaultOrder: 'joined_at.asc' }); } async findByKey(groupId, userId, select = '*') { const { data, error } = await supabase.from(this.table).select(select).eq('group_id', groupId).eq('user_id', userId).maybeSingle(); if (error) throw new ApiError(400, error.message); if (!data) throw new ApiError(404, 'group_members record not found.'); return data; } async updateByKey(groupId, userId, payload = {}) { const { data, error } = await supabase.from(this.table).update(payload).eq('group_id', groupId).eq('user_id', userId).select().maybeSingle(); if (error) throw new ApiError(400, error.message); if (!data) throw new ApiError(404, 'group_members record not found.'); return data; } async deleteByKey(groupId, userId) { const { data, error } = await supabase.from(this.table).delete().eq('group_id', groupId).eq('user_id', userId).select('group_id, user_id').maybeSingle(); if (error) throw new ApiError(400, error.message); if (!data) throw new ApiError(404, 'group_members record not found.'); return { deleted: true, groupId, userId }; } } module.exports = new GroupMemberModel();

const express = require('express'); const asyncHandler = require('../utils/asyncHandler'); function createCrudRouter(model) { const router = express.Router(); const listHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => { const data = await model.list(req.query); res.json(data); }); const getByIdHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => { const data = await model.findById(req.params.id, req.query.select || '*'); res.json(data); }); const createHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => { const data = await model.create(req.body); res.status(201).json(data); }); const updateHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => { const data = await model.updateById(req.params.id, req.body); res.json(data); }); const deleteHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => { const data = await model.deleteById(req.params.id); res.json(data); }); router.get('/', listHandler); router.get('/:id', getByIdHandler); router.post('/', createHandler); router.put('/:id', updateHandler); router.patch('/:id', updateHandler); router.delete('/:id', deleteHandler); return router; } module.exports = createCrudRouter;

const express = require('express'); const groupMemberModel = require('../models/groupMemberModel'); const asyncHandler = require('../utils/asyncHandler'); const router = express.Router(); const listHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => { const data = await groupMemberModel.list(req.query); res.json(data); }); const getByKeyHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => { const data = await groupMemberModel.findByKey(req.params.groupId, req.params.userId, req.query.select || '*'); res.json(data); }); const createHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => { const data = await groupMemberModel.create(req.body); res.status(201).json(data); }); const updateHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => { const data = await groupMemberModel.updateByKey(req.params.groupId, req.params.userId, req.body); res.json(data); }); const deleteHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => { const data = await groupMemberModel.deleteByKey(req.params.groupId, req.params.userId); res.json(data); }); router.get('/', listHandler); router.get('/:groupId/:userId', getByKeyHandler); router.post('/', createHandler); router.put('/:groupId/:userId', updateHandler); router.patch('/:groupId/:userId', updateHandler); router.delete('/:groupId/:userId', deleteHandler); module.exports = router;

const express = require('express'); const createCrudRouter = require('./crudRouter'); const groupMemberRoutes = require('./groupMemberRoutes'); const profileModel = require('../models/profileModel'); const groupModel = require('../models/groupModel'); const postModel = require('../models/postModel'); const commentModel = require('../models/commentModel'); const reactionModel = require('../models/reactionModel'); const notificationModel = require('../models/notificationModel'); const messageModel = require('../models/messageModel'); const router = express.Router(); router.use('/profiles', createCrudRouter(profileModel)); router.use('/groups', createCrudRouter(groupModel)); router.use('/group-members', groupMemberRoutes); router.use('/posts', createCrudRouter(postModel)); router.use('/comments', createCrudRouter(commentModel)); router.use('/reactions', createCrudRouter(reactionModel)); router.use('/notifications', createCrudRouter(notificationModel)); router.use('/messages', createCrudRouter(messageModel)); module.exports = router;
